mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.6% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.3 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives forward-looking equity earnings expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances despite HOUST > 1300.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 102.0 index points signals weakening manufacturing activity and broadening economic slowdown, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals broad-based demand strength, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST are rising, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in joint regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPI inflation above 3.0% combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures that delay rate cuts, increasing equity discount rates and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when both CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS >= 4.5%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 155,000 and a decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.6% signals a rapidly tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 50% of instances when both PAYEMS > 155000 and UNRATE < 3.6, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in joint model).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past 5 months, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates strong underlying demand momentum that supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances despite both GDPC1 and HOUST showing growth, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
